These six labeled 40-position cycles have 13 zeros and respectively 8–13 ones.
Additive symbol negation (interchanging 1 and 2) supplies witnesses with 19–14 ones.
Each cyclic four-gram is distinct, and no four-gram occurs together with its additive negative.
